title: ApplicationSet per-app config
description: Contents of k8s-apps/<app>/appset.yaml. Keys are flattened into the ApplicationSet git file generator template params. All keys are optional.

namespace.description: Destination namespace override (defaults to the app directory name)

serverSideApply.description: Set to false to disable server-side apply (enabled by default)

scaleToZero.description: Ignores .spec.replicas so the app can be scaled to zero without self-heal reverting it
